text:
Sam: quick async standup — kernel/batching/KV perf check
Sam: what I did: landed inline-kv-lookup patch (PR #4321), added a small fast-path for 1-token prefixes, ran a microbench on canary pool. p50 from ~18ms -> 16ms, p95 from ~78ms -> 65ms on our 1k-slot synthetic.
Sam: blocker: hit an OOM spike under microburst load when slot reuse hits >85% — reproducer attached below.
Sam: today: triage OOM, add mem-guard and better slot accounting; want a quick CR for the patch so we can roll to 25% canary.

Marta: saw the OOM traces, I can repro locally with loadgen. leaving a quick repro cmd:
```bash
./loadgen --target 400 --concurrency 32 --seq-len 512 --batching=on --endpoint http://canary.internal/infer
```
Marta: will run 30m smoke and paste flamegraph if it pops.

Leo: bench-bot: posted latest microbench summary: 2024-11-08 09:12 UTC — inline-kv patch
bench-bot: p50=16.1ms, p90=34.8ms, p95=65.3ms, tokens/sec=1420, mem-avg=3.1GB (per-worker).

Anya: quick CR ping — I can review PR #4321 today, please add a short changelog note about slot accounting and the new env var MEM_GUARD_RATIO. Also add a unit test for the eviction fastpath.

Sam: thanks @Anya — test + changelog incoming. @Marta if you can attach the smoke run logs that'd help narrow which op spikes memory.

Marta: smokes done, attaching snippet:
```
[smoke-run-summary]
requests=72000 duration=30m errors=2 peak-rss=3.9GB p95-latency=72ms
flame: /s3/smoke/1710456789-flame.svg
```
Marta: errors look tied to batch-split when concurrency surges.

Sam: noted — I toggled kv eviction threshold down to 0.6 in the canary (was 0.8). config snippet: `kv.evict_threshold=0.6`
Sam: hypothesis: higher threshold kept cold entries longer causing bigger KV footprint during splits. lowering should keep active set smaller and reduce OOM risk.

Leo: can we emit a metric for "kv_active_set_size" and a labelled "batch_split_count"? that will make the regression alertable.

Sam: adding metrics + a small dashboard tile in console. will wire an alert at kv_active_set_size > 2.5GB for 1m.

Anya: also suggest a canary rollout plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% with 15m holds and p95 latency check at each step. I'll add to the rollout config.

infra-bot: canary deployed to 10% (slotting-canary-2024-11-08) — health OK so far. :white_check_mark:

Sam: wrap-up: I’ll post PR and ping for review, will follow up with a short postmortem if the canary regresses. small ask: if anyone has spare cycles, please scan the batching codepath for allocations during split — likely place where we can shave ~200MB.

Marta: on it, will grep for temp buffers and log allocations.

Leo: acked, will add the two metrics and a Grafana tile draft.

Anya: will review PR after lunch. :coffee:

Sam: thanks team. end of thread.
